package.name: jedy_teleop
package.description:
Driving Jedy from a gamepad.
The part worth knowing is that the stick is not mapped onto 0..max speed. This base's wheels do not turn below about 0.085 m/s and saturate near 0.20, so a proportional stick leaves its bottom 42 % dead and then lurches. jedy_teleop.deadband maps a deflection onto what the base can actually do, scaling the whole twist so every ratio -- and therefore the heading -- is preserved.
